name: bundled-requirement-decomposition
body: `requirements.requirement.reviewer-upgrade-removal-guide` is distinct from the reviewer-distribution requirement `requirements.requirement.reviewer-is-distributed-not-generated`: it addresses the upgrade friction of a repo that already carries a repo-local `implementation-phase-reviewer.md`, and its manual-removal instruction is separately testable user-facing behaviour (`APG_UPGRADE_DOC` plus the `upgrade_doc_covers_version_field_gate_and_fix_steps` needle). It is parented under `requirements.user.apg-upgrader`, and `reviewer-is-distributed-not-generated` is parented under `requirements.stakeholder.agent-suite-maintainer`; the `contains` hierarchy stays a tree.
